decisions.record: The measures tool converts with a frame at MJD 0 and the geocentre
decisions.inputs: me.measure(me.direction('J2000','12h00m00','45d00m00'),'AZEL') in a fresh measures tool, with no doframe call.
decisions.casa: The tool starts with a default frame (MJD 0 UTC, zero-vector position, J2000 pole) and converts using it without a warning, returning AZEL for 1858-11-17 at the Earth's centre.
decisions.ours: Starts with an empty frame, so the conversion fails with 'Cannot convert due to missing frame information' until doframe sets the element.
decisions.rationale: A conversion should not silently use placeholder epoch and position.
decisions.impact: A script that forgot doframe gets an error rather than a meaningless answer.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 keeps the IAU 1980 sidereal time and ecliptic obliquities
decisions.inputs: Conversions to HADEC, AZEL, ITRF, MECLIPTIC or TECLIPTIC with measures.iau2000.b_use set.
decisions.casa: casacore still forms GAST from IAU 1982 GMST and the IAU 1980 equation of the equinoxes, and uses IAU 1980 obliquities (fundArg T^2 term -0.0059 arcsec, 0.37 mas in MECLIPTIC by 2026).
decisions.ours: Computes all of these as casacore does (casacore_sidereal, casacore_frames).
decisions.rationale: Follows casacore for parity; it moved IAU 2000A J2000 to HADEC from 20.4 to 16.7 mas off casacore.
decisions.impact: Results under IAU 2000 match casacore, including its remaining IAU 1980 pieces.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA's behaviour is deliberate or users' results depend on it, casa-rs follows it.

decisions.record: Direction latitudes come from an unnormalized vector
decisions.inputs: Direction conversions that use the galactic or FK4 matrices, e.g. B1950 to GALACTIC or J2000 to B1950 near a pole.
decisions.casa: The 10-digit literal matrices are orthogonal only to about 7e-11 and doConvert does not renormalize, so getLat's asin(z) is off by (|v|-1)tan(b) and becomes NaN once z exceeds 1.
decisions.ours: Converts with the same matrices, renormalizes and reports the latitude of the unit vector.
decisions.impact: Reported angles differ by up to 51 microarcsec (1.6 mas at b=-89.77 deg) while directions agree to 0.01 microarcsec.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 JMEAN to J2000 applies bias and precession in the wrong order
decisions.inputs: MECLIPTIC or TECLIPTIC to J2000 conversion under IAU 2000.
decisions.casa: deapplyPrecession applies B then P giving P*B*v', not the inverse B*P*v', so JMEAN to J2000 is not the inverse of J2000 to JMEAN (0.14 mas off in 2026, growing).
decisions.rationale: The reverse transform must invert the forward one.
decisions.impact: Round trips through the IAU 2000 ecliptics differ from casacore by 0.14 mas in 2026.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

decisions.record: IAU 2000 GMST1 adds the TT day fraction
decisions.inputs: UT1 to GMST1 (and so LMST) under IAU 2000.
decisions.casa: UT1_GMST1 adds GMST00/(2pi), already a sidereal time of day, to the TT epoch, counting the TT day fraction twice: UT1 51544.5 gives GMST1 58258.280 against 58257.779, and GMST1_UT1 does not undo it.
decisions.ours: Uses the IAU 1976 GMST1 under either model, as casacore's own GAST does.
decisions.rationale: This keeps GMST1, LMST, GAST and LAST consistent with each other.
decisions.impact: LMST differs from casacore's IAU 2000 value but agrees with casacore under IAU 1976.
decisions.owner_decision: Standing rule, AGENTS.md "CASA deviations" (owner, #1054): where CASA crashes, aborts, reads out of bounds, loses or corrupts data, or contradicts its documentation or evident intent, casa-rs corrects it.

casa-values.result: 39 of the 78 tests pass against CASA 6.7.6.14's own me tool, including every measure, conversion and query value. Of the 39 others, 30 test what only casa-rs has, 8 assert messages CASA writes to its own log, and 1 is the recorded empty-frame decision; the receipt classifies each. casa-rs passes the same tests in CI.

Passes in the Python tests.
